name: Black Box
objective: Find the hidden balls in the box by bouncing laser beams off them.
controls: Click outside the box to fire a laser; click inside to mark a ball. Right-click marks an empty square.

name: Bridges
objective: Connect all the islands with a network of bridges.
controls: Drag between islands to add bridges; repeat to make a double bridge. Right-drag marks no bridge.

name: Cube
objective: Pick up all the blue squares by rolling the cube over them.
controls: Click beside the cube or use arrow keys to roll. Pick up every blue square.

name: Dominosa
objective: Tile the rectangle with a full set of dominoes.
controls: Click between two numbers to join them. Right-click marks a boundary.

name: Fifteen
objective: Slide the tiles around to arrange them into order.
controls: Click a tile in the empty square's row or column to slide it; arrow keys also move tiles.

name: Filling
objective: Mark every square with the area of its containing region.
controls: Click a square and type its region size. Drag to copy a number; Backspace clears it.

name: Flip
objective: Flip groups of squares to light them all up at once.
controls: Click a square to flip it and the squares linked to it. Make every square light.

name: Flood
objective: Turn the grid the same colour in as few flood fills as possible.
controls: Click a colour to flood the top-left region with it. Number keys also select colours.

name: Galaxies
objective: Divide the grid into rotationally symmetric regions each centred on a dot.
controls: Drag borders to outline symmetric regions around dots. Right-click marks cells as belonging to a dot.

name: Guess
objective: Guess the hidden combination of colours.
controls: Click pegs to choose colours, then click the feedback area to submit. Right-click cycles backwards.

name: Inertia
objective: Collect all the gems without running into any of the mines.
controls: Click in any of eight directions to slide; arrows or numeric keypad also move. Space follows a hint after Solve. Undo can recover from a mine.

name: Keen
objective: Complete the latin square in accordance with the arithmetic clues.
controls: Click a square and type a number. Right-click enters pencil marks; Backspace clears.

name: Light Up
objective: Place bulbs to light up all the squares.
controls: Left-click places a bulb. Right-click marks an empty square. Light all squares without bulbs seeing each other.

name: Loopy
objective: Draw a single closed loop, given clues about number of adjacent edges.
controls: Left-click draws a loop edge; right-click marks an unused edge. Click again to clear.

name: Magnets
objective: Place magnets to satisfy the clues and avoid like poles touching.
controls: Left-click cycles magnet polarity; right-click marks a blank domino.

name: Map
objective: Colour the map so that adjacent regions are never the same colour.
controls: Drag a colour from a coloured region to another region. Right-drag makes pencil marks.

name: Mines
objective: Find all the mines without treading on any of them.
controls: Left-click opens or chords; right-click flags. Arrows move; Enter opens; Space flags.

name: Mosaic
objective: Fill in the grid given clues about number of nearby black squares.
controls: Left-click fills a square; right-click empties it. Drag to paint a run; middle-click clears.

name: Net
objective: Rotate each tile to reassemble the network.
controls: Left/right click rotate; middle or Shift-left locks. Arrows move; A/S rotate; D or Space locks.

name: Netslide
objective: Slide a row at a time to reassemble the network.
controls: Click arrows outside the grid to slide a row or column. Reassemble the powered network.

name: Palisade
objective: Divide the grid into equal-sized areas in accordance with the clues.
controls: Left-click draws a border; right-click marks no border. Drag to extend a line.

name: Pattern
objective: Fill in the pattern in the grid, given only the lengths of runs of black squares.
controls: Left-click paints black; right-click paints white; middle-click clears. Drag to fill a run.

name: Pearl
objective: Draw a single closed loop, given clues about corner and straight squares.
controls: Left-click draws a loop edge; right-click marks an unused edge. Drag to continue.

name: Pegs
objective: Jump pegs over each other to remove all but one.
controls: Drag a peg over an adjacent peg into an empty hole to remove the jumped peg.

name: Range
objective: Place black squares to limit the visible distance from each numbered cell.
controls: Left-click marks black; right-click marks white. Repeat a click to clear a square.

name: Rectangles
objective: Divide the grid into rectangles with areas equal to the numbers.
controls: Drag between opposite corners to draw a rectangle. Right-drag removes borders.

name: Same Game
objective: Clear the grid by removing touching groups of the same colour squares.
controls: Click a connected group to select it; click again to remove it. Larger groups score more.

name: Signpost
objective: Connect the squares into a path following the arrows.
controls: Drag from one square to its successor in the arrow direction. Right-drag disconnects a link.

name: Singles
objective: Black out the right set of duplicate numbers.
controls: Left-click blackens a square; right-click circles it to keep it white.

name: Sixteen
objective: Slide a row at a time to arrange the tiles into order.
controls: Click arrows outside the grid to slide a whole row or column into order.

name: Slant
objective: Draw a maze of slanting lines that matches the clues.
controls: Left/right click choose a diagonal; repeated clicking cycles the square. Avoid closed loops.

name: Solo
objective: Fill in the grid so that each row, column and square block contains one of every digit.
controls: Click and type digits. Right-click enters pencil marks; Backspace clears. Letters follow 9 on larger grids.

name: Tents
objective: Place a tent next to each tree.
controls: Left-click places a tent; right-click marks grass. Drag to paint several squares.

name: Towers
objective: Complete the latin square of towers in accordance with the clues.
controls: Click and type a tower height. Right-click enters pencil marks; Backspace clears.

name: Tracks
objective: Fill in the railway track according to the clues.
controls: Left-drag lays track; right-drag marks no track. Click an edge to toggle a connection.

name: Twiddle
objective: Rotate the tiles around themselves to arrange them into order.
controls: Click a group to rotate it anticlockwise; right-click rotates clockwise. Arrow keys move the cursor.

name: Undead
objective: Place ghosts, vampires and zombies so that the right numbers of them can be seen in mirrors.
controls: Click a square and type G, V or Z for a ghost, vampire or zombie. Right-click uses pencil marks.

name: Unequal
objective: Complete the latin square in accordance with the > signs.
controls: Click and type a number. Right-click enters pencil marks; Backspace clears.

name: Unruly
objective: Fill in the black and white grid to avoid runs of three.
controls: Left-click chooses black; right-click chooses white. Repeat to clear; avoid three in a row.

name: Untangle
objective: Reposition the points so that the lines do not cross.
controls: Drag the points until no lines cross. The window can be resized to give more room.
